events.title: The Beginning of the seventh millennium.
events.description: This marks the beginning of the seventh millennium. There was four thousand years (four millennium) from Adam to Jesus and Two thousand years (two millennium) from Jesus to 01-01-01. ( This is considered the Church Age). There was no year Zero therefore the completion of the two thousand years was at the end of 2000 and not the beginning of the year 2000.

events.title: Shabbat Nachamu
events.description: Shabbat Nachamu means "Sabbath of Consolation." Shabbat Nachamu is the first of seven haftarot (Lit. conclusion. A reading from the Prophets, read along with the weekly Torah portion) starting with the Shabbat after Tisha B'Av (9th of Av) and leading up to Rosh Hashanah. These readings are meant to console us after the destruction of the Temple and reassure us that it will be built again. …
